title: Skin and Bones

phrase.direction: Shiver, tiptoe, freeze! Press Start story. Each lyric and ooh waits for your next press.

director.notes: Shiver, tiptoe, freeze! Press Start story. Each lyric and ooh waits for your next press.

scenes.name: Verse 1 · By the fire
scenes.caption: There was an old woman all skin and bones.

phrase.direction: She turns toward us as her shadow stretches. Copy her little shiver, then press Next.

director.notes: She turns toward us as her shadow stretches. Copy her little shiver, then press Next.

phrase.direction: Shiver with her and sing the rising ooh. Press Next when ready.

director.notes: Shiver with her and sing the rising ooh. Press Next when ready.

scenes.name: Verse 2 · Her cottage
scenes.caption: She lived down by the old graveyard.

phrase.direction: Her warm cottage stands beside the distant graveyard. Point to the graves, then press Next.

director.notes: Her warm cottage stands beside the distant graveyard. Point to the graves, then press Next.

phrase.direction: Trace the floating ooh in the moonlit sky. Press Next when ready.

director.notes: Trace the floating ooh in the moonlit sky. Press Next when ready.

scenes.name: Verse 3 · Leaving home
scenes.caption: One night she thought she’d take a walk.

phrase.direction: Her door opens. She raises her lantern and steps down the path. Tiptoe along with her.

director.notes: Her door opens. She raises her lantern and steps down the path. Tiptoe along with her.

phrase.direction: Tiptoe and follow the ooh rising from her lantern. Press Next when ready.

director.notes: Tiptoe and follow the ooh rising from her lantern. Press Next when ready.

scenes.name: Verse 4 · Through the graveyard
scenes.caption: She walked down by the old graveyard.

phrase.direction: Tiptoe between the headstones. Did something move behind that one? Press Next when ready.

director.notes: Tiptoe between the headstones. Did something move behind that one? Press Next when ready.

phrase.direction: Watch the headstone: can you spot the peeking ooh? Sing, then press Next.

scenes.caption: She saw the bones a-layin’ around.

phrase.direction: Her lantern reveals the bones. One rolls! Freeze with her until the next press.

director.notes: Her lantern reveals the bones. One rolls! Freeze with her until the next press.

phrase.direction: Freeze, then tiptoe home with her as you sing. Press Next when ready.

director.notes: Freeze, then tiptoe home with her as you sing. Press Next when ready.

scenes.name: Verse 6 · The broom closet
scenes.caption: She went to the closet to get a broom.

phrase.direction: Back inside her cottage, she reaches toward the closet handle.

director.notes: Back inside her cottage, she reaches toward the closet handle.

phrase.direction: Sing the last ooh softly. Hold still and press Next for the door.

director.notes: Sing the last ooh softly. Hold still and press Next for the door.

phrase.direction: Everybody freeze. The closet is dark. Hold the suspense—the next press reveals BOO!

director.notes: Everybody freeze. The closet is dark. Hold the suspense—the next press reveals BOO!

phrase.direction: You did it! Restart to sing and play again.

director.notes: You did it! Restart to sing and play again.

filmBrief: Traditional song. Fourteen independently triggered song cues plus a title screen. Opens by the fire, establishes the cottage, walks into the graveyard, discovers rolling bones, and returns to the wall-mounted closet. Six distinct ooh flights. Shiver, tiptoe and freeze prompts. Students sing live. The door and BOO are separate cues. Every cue waits indefinitely for Next, Space, or Right Arrow. Left Arrow goes back; Home restarts.
